name: PostHarvestPro
description: Browser-based platform for postharvest physiology and technology: quality, maturity and CIELAB colour; deterioration kinetics, Arrhenius, Q10 and shelf life, including time to rejection with censoring; respiration, ethylene, modified atmospheres and precooling; losses along the value chain and mechanical damage; discrimination, affective and descriptive sensory evaluation; postharvest trials; packaging and cold-storage calculators; and a self-contained report. No installation, no internet, validated against independent implementations.
